action.new_text:
def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
                      (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
                      (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D array")
        if np.any(np.isnan(arr)) or np.any(np.isinf(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be nonpositive")

    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input arrays must have the same shape")

    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)) or isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative threshold")
    if tau_filter < 0 or np.isinf(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    if raw_weights.sum() == 0:
        raise ValueError("future_horizon must be positive")
    weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Weighted sums
    weighted_with_result = logp_with_result @ weights
    weighted_call_only = logp_call_only @ weights
    weighted_no_call = logp_no_call @ weights

    # Improvements
    imp_no_call = weighted_with_result - weighted_no_call
    imp_call_only = weighted_with_result - weighted_call_only

    # Margin and keep mask
    margin = np.minimum(imp_no_call, imp_call_only)
    keep = margin > tau_filter

    return keep, margin
